description: An old conifer standing alone on an open ridge, whole tree in frame from the side. Three stems from the base; the crown is broad with a flattened, uneven top. Foliage sits in dense tufts at the ends of bare, contorted limbs. Overcast.

habit.stems_from_base.evidence: three trunks meet the ground together at lower centre

habit.crown_outline.evidence: the whole crown outline; flattened, broken top

habit.widest_at.evidence: crown spreads widest in its upper third

habit.crown_profile.evidence: ticks drawn on the crop from the stems' foot to the highest tuft
habit.crown_profile.note: three stems read as one outline; a boulder hides the left side of the lowest band

habit.see_through.evidence: sky shows between the limb-end tufts across the crown

arch.main_limbs.evidence: limbs traced from the stems into the crown

arch.limb_hierarchy.evidence: a few thick limbs, each ending in many thin twigs

arch.limb_course.evidence: the thick limbs on the left change direction at each fork

foliage.placement.evidence: dark tufts at the ends of bare limbs all round

unlisted: Several dead grey snags stand among the living stems.
